specification: WWCP_POI.TS 0.2.0 (README, experimental) and WWCP_POI3/Verifier of WWCP_POI; documents of test-vectors/runs/chargy-fc513cd
description: The verifier extensions of WWCP_POI.TS 0.2.0, which WWCP_POI3 has as well: no part of SPECIFICATION.md but the usages chargeTransparencyRecords and witnessPublications. Each vector names a check ("kind"), its inputs as documents of the run (a file and a JSON pointer, read on into a string, which is a JSON document of its own) and what both implementations give of it ("result", normalized), or that it is refused. "trust" is a trust anchor and a key statement, every identity key of the anchor trusted, current or historical, at a time.

vectors.description: The key of the meter of DE*POI*E1*1 its station proof gives, at the time the session was generated.

Container key differs; signatures pass with the proven EVSE key; conflict stays visible, including after export/reimport: the proof gives the same key; the key of the container is no input of the binding.
Valid attested station associates another key; original reading signatures fail with it: the binding is of the key the proof gives; that the readings do not verify with it is the app's check.
End reading changed without signing again; static proof still passes but measurement signature fails: the binding is of the proof alone.
Valid proof lists two candidates; no automatic trial selection: asked for one by its identification, that one is bound.
Original signatures and RNO assignment at signed times pass; commit inclusion passes; independent witness/time pending.
The same, with the witness of trusted-witnesses.json trusted and one witness required: the checkpoint is witnessed.
The same, from a historical trust context of the key statement the proof of that time gives, expired today.

Expired bootstrap can be inspected/imported explicitly as a historical reference; current validity stays expired and each unknown key requires manual trust. No newly issued statement/server is needed: a historical trust context of it.
Assignment and signatures pass; inclusion remains pending.

Two non-overlapping RNO-attested assignments validate both original signatures with different keys; the container's single key conflicts with the second key; inclusion/succession history deliberately absent.
